source_records.title: Bulenox homepage
source_records.short_quote: No minimum trading days. Payouts everyday.
source_records.notes: Official homepage: three paths (Qualification/Master/Funded), two risk models, no minimum trading days, news trading allowed, trade until 15:59 CT, no monthly fees on Master, 4 CME Group exchanges, 20+ platforms, Rithmic/NinjaTrader partners.

source_records.title: Bulenox Accounts & Pricing
source_records.short_quote: Two risk models. Choose one before you buy.
source_records.notes: Official pricing page: Qualification / Fast Track / Momentum account types; Option 1 Trailing vs Option 2 EOD risk models locked for life; always-on coupon BULENOX; professional vs non-professional Rithmic data declaration ($116/mo if professional, $0 if non-professional). Plan price cards are JS-rendered and could not be read via text fetch. | 2026-10-26: card prices, coupon block and pro data-fee text were re-read in BX_S11/BX_S12; this baseline source record (checked 2026-10-19) is kept for rows that were not re-read.

source_records.title: BULENOX LLC Master Account Agreement
source_records.short_quote: Trader must not allow Account Balance to hit the Maximum Threshold Drawdown.
source_records.notes: Official agreement document hosted on Bulenox JotForm account (sections 5, 10, 12, 13 visible): trading hours, position limits, allowed products, trailing/EOD drawdown amounts, daily loss limits, 40% consistency, inactivity, payout schedule/splits/minimums/maximums/safety threshold reserve, tax status, termination.

source_records.title: Bulenox Activation Fee guide (quantvps, secondary)
source_records.short_quote: Each Master Account requires a separate one-time activation fee
source_records.notes: SECONDARY LEAD ONLY, not evidence. Quotes Bulenox Help Center; reports prices as listed on bulenox.com on 2026-10-10: Qualification $145/$175/$215/$325, Momentum $94/$143/$248/$358, Fast Track $338/$488/$648/$788; activation fees $143/$148/$248/$498; reset $78; ES $2.09/side, MES $0.61/side commissions.

source_records.title: Bulenox Payout & Consistency Rules 2026 (quantvps, secondary)
source_records.short_quote: no single day contributes more than 40% of your total profits
source_records.notes: SECONDARY LEAD ONLY, not evidence. Reports payout rules checked 2026-10-10: 10 trading days, 40% rule, safety reserve, Wednesday processing, Friday 11:59 PM CT cutoff; Fast Track first-payout goals and 20/25/30% consistency; Momentum 5 qualifying days, 35% consistency, min balances and caps.

source_records.title: Bulenox Review Top 10 Prop Firm 2026 (top10proptrading, secondary)
source_records.short_quote: all one-time purchases with no monthly billing since August 17, 2026
source_records.notes: SECONDARY LEAD ONLY, not evidence. Reports: one-time pricing since 2026-08-17; Qualification 30-day window, $78 reset not extending window; Momentum 30-day eval, 5 qualifying days, 35% consistency; Fast Track no eval, 20/25/30% consistency; Option 1 vs Option 2 mechanics.

source_records.title: Bulenox Account Types Explained (bulenox-deals, secondary)
source_records.short_quote: Momentum is the cheapest way to reach a funded Master account
source_records.notes: SECONDARY LEAD ONLY, not evidence. States figures checked against official Bulenox Help Center Sep 2026: Qualification sizes/targets/fees (25K $145 target $1500 DD $1500; 50K $175/$3000/$2500; 100K $215/$6000/$3000; 150K $325/$9000/$4500); $250K tier withdrawn from public pricing.

source_records.title: Bulenox Prop Firm Review (joinprop, secondary)
source_records.short_quote: Trader is entitled to withdraw safety threshold reserve upon the termination
source_records.notes: SECONDARY LEAD ONLY, not evidence. Quotes Master Account Agreement language: safety threshold reserve withdrawable on termination; mandatory Funded transition quote; ~90 restricted countries claim; one account per person claim; HFT/scalping-algo prohibition claim.

source_records.title: Bulenox Rules guide (bulenoxtrader, secondary)
source_records.short_quote: The activation link expires seven days after Bulenox sends it
source_records.notes: SECONDARY LEAD ONLY, not evidence. Reports: 7-day activation link expiry; $78 qualification reset; EOD DLL pauses trading (not a violation); Momentum/Fast Track drawdown $1000 on 25K.

source_records.notes: SECONDARY LEAD ONLY, not evidence. Reports: no consistency rule and no minimum trading days in Qualification; Master not live capital, later invite to live Funded; EOD scaling vs no-scaling descriptions.
